prompt:
Edit image 1, the APPROVED full-body Persona 5 Joker game-character sprite summon_rip_a2, into the next finishing gesture. Image 1 is the EDIT BASE for identity, face, exact head dimensions, costume, torso proportions and polished P5 ink/cel rendering. Image 2 idle_a3 is ONLY the reference for standing foot spacing and body scale, not its arm pose.
Continue the raised RIGHT hand's current outward-upward direction: extend the right arm farther diagonally outward toward the UPPER LEFT of the picture (his own right side, the same side as the already raised arm in image 1). The right elbow opens and the arm stretches, still with a soft natural bend; the right red-gloved hand opens with fingers spread as if letting go of an invisible edge. No object in hand. The hand is well away from the head, not above or against the hair. ONLY this right arm is raised. LEFT arm and empty left hand hang naturally down beside the left thigh, as in image 1.
Body stands UPRIGHT, chest open, spine straight, hips over feet; knees nearly straight with a relaxed standing posture. Open the feet from image 1's close stance to approximately the same comfortable stance as idle_a3, around 1.2 shoulder widths, NOT a squat, deep knee bend or exaggerated wide-legged stance. Slim torso, leg length, boot size and head size must stay equal to the base and idle_a3.
A strong upward draft lifts the bottom of the coat upward and BACK behind the body; show swept, lifted coat tails and fluttering folds, not drawn airflow or energy lines. Hair tips are blown upward/back a little while preserving the head size and recognizable hair silhouette. Head tilts up only slightly, eyes still look forward toward screen RIGHT, not up at the sky; natural gray irises with bright highlights and rounded chin, same face identity and drawing as image 1.
Preserve black high-collared long coat, gray gold-chained waistcoat, red gloves, black trousers and brown boots, sharp expressive ink outlines and hard cel shading. NO MASK on face or in hand, no prop, no flames, aura, wind lines, blood, glow, trails, text, ground shadow or visual effects. Only the character and physically lifted clothes/hair.
Genuinely transparent RGBA background, 1024x1536 portrait, full character scale like idle_a3 with soles near y1500. All hair, extended fingers, coat tails and both feet entirely inside the canvas with a small clear margin. No shrinking body or enlarging head to fit the arm.
Precision for this redraw: copy the BASE and idle head scale accurately. The complete hair-top-to-rounded-chin distance should be approximately 225 pixels on this 1024x1536 canvas, matching idle_a3, not a small 200-pixel head. Hair top around y15-25, chin around y240-250, soles around y1510. Keep normal head width and same slim body proportions as the references; do not miniaturize the head to make the extended arm look longer. Preserve chin-to-sole torso/leg length close to idle_a3. Wind moves individual hair tips backward without reducing the hair mass. Entire arm and coat still fit within the canvas.
